ModMetaData.name: Zoology: Realistic Animal Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: AbobaShark
ModMetaData.description: Zoology rebuilds RimWorld animal biology from species data: growth and life stages, sexual dimorphism, animal graphics, natural attacks and Combat Extended balance, predator-prey ecology, herd behavior, reproduction and offspring care. Animals can use tree refuges, burrows and nests; amphibians reproduce through aquatic roe and tadpoles; compatible animals can be housed in barns. Species-specific ecology, lactation, scavenging, bionics and cross-mod support complete the overhaul.
